options.name: progression_balancing
options.description:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: accessibility
options.description:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: archive_logs
options.description:
Add the 50 archive log collectibles as extra CHECK locations.

EXPERIMENTAL / currently non-functional: the in-game archive collection
flags have not been confirmed, so collecting a log does not reliably fire
a check. Leave this off for now.

options.name: mission_reward_multiplier
options.description:
How many item checks each mission/arena/rank objective awards.

Every story-progression check, key mission, arena rank, and mercenary rank
fires this many times, so a single objective can hand out multiple items.
Higher values mean more items per run and a denser seed.

1x: one item per objective (default)
2x: two items per objective
3x: three items per objective
4x: four items per objective

Note: at 4x across all categories the seed uses nearly the entire part
catalogue (~312 of 314 parts), so there is little variety between seeds.
Lower values leave more parts rotating in/out each seed.

options.name: goal
options.description:
Which ending counts as goal completion.

any_ending:   completing Route A, B, or C all count as victory.
route_a:      only the Fires of Ibis ending counts.
route_b:      only the Liberator of Rubicon ending counts.
route_c:      only the Alea Iacta Est ending counts.
all_endings:  all three routes must be completed (NG++ required).

options.name: local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be in their native world.

options.name: non_local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be outside their native world.

options.name: start_inventory
options.description: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: "Bomb: 1"

options.name: start_hints
options.description: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.

options.name: start_location_hints
options.description: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
